items.title: Even Other AI Labs Are Rallying Around Anthropic’s Slowdown Proposal
items.summary: Dario Amodei's 3,000-word essay 'We Must Pace the Frontier' did what no AI safety missive has managed: it pulled Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Demis Hassabis, and Satya Nadella publicly onto the same page — replacing vague risk vibes with specific, debatable proposals. Between the pile-on, the IPO-cynicism, and the antitrust hand-wringing, the real story may be that the negotiation over AI's next phase has formally begun.
